label: SIMULATED default decline table. Wording and timing are invented, not observed. Replace the entries with the one real decline from data/real-card-test.md once it exists [F40]; only OVER_LIMIT is calibrated by that test, the other codes stay SIMULATED [F1].

OVER_LIMIT.wording: SIMULATED decline: the amount is above the limit set on this card.

CARD_USED.wording: SIMULATED decline: this single use card has already been used.

CARD_VOIDED.wording: SIMULATED decline: this card was cancelled before it was used.

CARD_EXPIRED.wording: SIMULATED decline: this card has expired.

UNKNOWN_HANDLE.wording: SIMULATED decline: this card is not recognised.

MERCHANT_MISMATCH.wording: SIMULATED decline: this card is locked to a different merchant. The merchant lock is a simulated feature; the real card has none [F1].
